deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL provide one shared sign-in page for platform operators and client users.

requirement.name: Shared sign-in entry point
requirement.text: The system SHALL provide one shared sign-in page for platform operators and client users.

scenarios.name: Unauthenticated user opens a protected route
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user without a valid session opens a protected application route
- **THEN** the system SHALL direct the user to the shared sign-in page

scenarios.name: Public registration is unavailable
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a visitor attempts to access public registration
- **THEN** the system SHALL prevent public self-registration

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL use Better Auth for authentication and PostgreSQL for persistent authentication data.

requirement.name: Secure authentication
requirement.text: The system SHALL use Better Auth for authentication and PostgreSQL for persistent authentication data.

scenarios.name: Successful sign-in
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user submits valid credentials
- **THEN** the system SHALL establish an authenticated session through Better Auth

scenarios.name: Invalid sign-in
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user submits invalid credentials
- **THEN** the system SHALL reject authentication

requirement.name: Protected operations verify the session
requirement.text: The system SHALL verify the current authenticated session on the server before performing protected operations.

scenarios.name: Session is missing or invalid
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user requests a protected operation without a valid session
- **THEN** the system SHALL reject the operation and SHALL NOT disclose protected data

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL grant platform operator privileges only to authenticated users whose verified user IDs appear in the server-side operator allowlist.

requirement.name: Operator authorization uses a server-side allowlist
requirement.text: The system SHALL grant platform operator privileges only to authenticated users whose verified user IDs appear in the server-side operator allowlist.

scenarios.name: Allowlisted operator signs in
scenarios.rawText:

- **THEN** the system SHALL authorize the user for permitted operator operations

scenarios.name: User is not allowlisted
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an authenticated user's verified ID does not appear in the operator allowlist
- **THEN** the system SHALL NOT grant platform operator privileges

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL authorize platform operators independently of client organization membership.

requirement.name: Operator access is independent of organization membership

scenarios.name: Operator has no organization membership
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an allowlisted operator has a valid session but belongs to no organization
- **THEN** the system SHALL allow access to authorized operator routes
- **AND** SHALL NOT redirect the operator to a client onboarding or membership-required page

requirement.name: Operator privileges cannot be self-assigned
requirement.text: The system SHALL NOT derive platform operator privileges from client-controlled data.

scenarios.name: User changes client-side role information
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user modifies client-side state, request data, URL parameters, or organization role information to claim operator privileges
- **THEN** the system SHALL reject the unauthorized privilege claim

scenarios.name: Non-operator requests an operator operation
scenarios.rawText:

- **THEN** the system SHALL deny the operation
- **AND** SHALL NOT disclose protected operator data or perform the requested mutation

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL allow an authorized platform operator to create client user accounts without enabling public self-registration.

requirement.name: Operator-created client accounts
requirement.text: The system SHALL allow an authorized platform operator to create client user accounts without enabling public self-registration.

scenarios.name: Operator creates a client account
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an authorized operator submits valid client account details
- **THEN** the system creates the client account through supported server-side authentication APIs
- **AND** the system reports success only after verifying account creation

scenarios.name: Unauthorized account creation
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user without platform operator privileges attempts to create a client account
- **THEN** the system rejects the request
- **AND** no client account is created

requirements.name: Operator-created client accounts
requirements.text: The system SHALL allow an authorized platform operator to create client user accounts without enabling public self-registration.

- **THEN** the system rejects the request

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL associate each provisioned client account with the intended organization and approved client role.

requirement.name: Client organization membership
requirement.text: The system SHALL associate each provisioned client account with the intended organization and approved client role.

scenarios.name: Client account is assigned to an organization
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an authorized operator provisions a client account for an organization
- **THEN** the account receives the intended organization membership and approved client role
- **AND** the account receives no platform operator privileges

scenarios.name: Invalid organization assignment
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** provisioning references an invalid or unauthorized organization
- **THEN** the system rejects the operation without creating an incorrectly assigned account

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL allow an authorized operator to set an initial client password using a password-setting mechanism supported by the installed authentication library.

requirement.name: Initial client password
requirement.text: The system SHALL allow an authorized operator to set an initial client password using a password-setting mechanism supported by the installed authentication library.

scenarios.name: Initial password is set
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an authorized operator provisions a client account with a valid initial password
- **THEN** the password is processed using the authentication library's supported secure password-storage mechanism
- **AND** the client can authenticate using the initial credentials

scenarios.name: Password confidentiality
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the system processes or stores an initial password
- **THEN** it never stores or logs the password in plaintext
- **AND** it does not expose the password through URLs, analytics, error messages, or unrelated responses

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL handle provisioning failures without granting unauthorized access or reporting unverified success.

requirement.name: Secure onboarding failure handling
requirement.text: The system SHALL handle provisioning failures without granting unauthorized access or reporting unverified success.

scenarios.name: Account provisioning fails
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** organization or account provisioning fails
- **THEN** the system reports the failure accurately
- **AND** it does not report onboarding as complete unless the required state has been verified

scenarios.name: Public registration remains disabled
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an unauthenticated visitor attempts public self-registration
- **THEN** the system rejects the registration request
- **AND** client account creation remains restricted to authorized operator provisioning

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL verify a user's authorization for the relevant organization on the server before allowing organization-scoped operations.

requirement.name: Organization access is verified on the server
requirement.text: The system SHALL verify a user's authorization for the relevant organization on the server before allowing organization-scoped operations.

scenarios.name: Member accesses an authorized organization
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an authenticated user requests an organization-scoped resource for an organization they are authorized to access
- **THEN** the system SHALL allow the operation according to the user's permissions

scenarios.name: User accesses an unauthorized organization
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** an authenticated user requests an organization-scoped resource for an organization they are not authorized to access
- **THEN** the system SHALL deny the operation
- **AND** SHALL NOT disclose the organization's protected data

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL NOT trust a client-supplied organization ID as evidence that a user may access that organization.

requirement.name: Client-supplied organization identifiers are not proof of authorization
requirement.text: The system SHALL NOT trust a client-supplied organization ID as evidence that a user may access that organization.

scenarios.name: User substitutes another organization's ID
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user changes an organization ID in a URL, request body, query parameter, or other client-controlled input
- **THEN** the system SHALL independently verify authorization for the requested organization
- **AND** SHALL reject access when authorization is absent

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL scope organization-owned data access to the authorized organization.

requirement.name: Organization-scoped reads and writes are tenant-isolated
requirement.text: The system SHALL scope organization-owned data access to the authorized organization.

scenarios.name: Authorized member reads organization data
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a member reads organization-owned data
- **THEN** the system SHALL return only data belonging to an organization the member is authorized to access

scenarios.name: User attempts a cross-tenant mutation
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** a user attempts to create, modify, or delete organization-owned data outside an organization they are authorized to access
- **THEN** the system SHALL reject the operation
- **AND** SHALL leave the unauthorized organization's data unchanged
